svg.title: Recovery after a crash
svg.desc: After a restart the ambassador reads the journal for intents that have no outcome. For each one it follows what the capability declares: it verifies with the external system, resends, or stops and reports the outcome as unknown. Then it records the outcome. Find what is unknown: 1. Ambassador calls Journal: unfinished intents. 2. Journal replies to Ambassador: intent, no outcome. Reconcile: If verify: 3a. Ambassador calls External system: did you receive it. 4a. External system replies to Ambassador: yes or no. If resend: 3b. Ambassador calls External system: send again. 4b. External system replies to Ambassador: result. Otherwise: 3c. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: outcome unknown, refused. Close: 5. Ambassador sends to Journal: record outcome.
